text: どうだ　おしえて　ほしいか？

structure.jp: おしえて　ほしいか？
structure.en: do you want me to teach you?

patterns.name: 〜てほしい
patterns.explanation: ほしい after a て-form means you want someone else to do the thing for you. おしえて　ほしい = 'want (me) to teach (you)'.

patterns.name: 〜か (question)
patterns.explanation: か at the end turns the sentence into a question; straight after a plain word it sounds blunt and manly. ほしいか = 'do you want it?'
